title: A local clique density theorem in $H$-free graphs
summary: In 2016, Reiher's clique density theorem determined the minimum number of copies of $K_t$ in a graph with a prescribed edge density. In this paper, we investigate its local version and prove a local clique density theorem in $H$-free graphs as follows.
